::: {#exm-sample-median}
#### Median cholesterol in the WCGS

```{r}
median(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
```

The median cholesterol is a little lower than the mean
(@exm-sample-mean),
because the few participants with very high cholesterol
(the maximum is `r max(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)` mg/dL)
pull the mean upward
but do not change which value is in the middle.
A median is less sensitive to extreme values than a mean.
:::
